articles.summary: CLINTON, N.J., July 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Unity Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: UNTY), parent company of Unity Bank, reported net income of $14.5 million, or $1.42 per diluted share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared to net income of $14.3 million, or $1.40 per diluted share for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. For the six months ended June 30, 2026, Unity Bancorp reported net income of $28.8 million, or $2.82 per diluted share, compared to net income of $28.1 million, or $2.74 per dil
articles.title: Unity Bancorp Reports Quarterly Earnings of $14.5 Million
